transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, my wife actually wanted me to come in. We've been having some disagreements lately... mostly about her job. 

For the past year or so, I've just been noticing these patterns. I know she says the late meetings and these little changes in how she writes her work messages are just normal office stuff, but... they just line up too precisely to feel accidental. To me, it really seems like there’s a private signal in them, like they're meant to tell me something she just won’t say directly. So, I guess I'm here to talk about that.
How long have you been noticing these patterns in your wife's behavior?
Well, like I mentioned a moment ago, it's been about a year now. It really started right around the time she went back to working outside the home again.
Do you believe your wife is actually sending you these hidden signals, or could there be another explanation for the patterns you're seeing?

I've tried to think of other explanations, I really have. I mean, I know she tells me it's just normal office stuff, like I said earlier. But... yes, I do believe she's actually sending them. 

When you sit down and look at the late meetings and those specific little changes in her messages... they just line up way too precisely to be an accident. It really feels like a private signal meant just for me, like she's trying to tell me something she just won't say directly to my face. So, no, I haven't really found another explanation that makes sense of it all.
Have you ever had a period where you didn't believe your wife was sending you these hidden signals?

Not really, no. Um... once I started noticing it about a year ago, it's just been pretty consistent. I haven't really had a block of time where it went away or where I thought I was wrong about it. It's just... it's been there ever since she went back to the office.
Has anything or anyone ever been able to convince you, even for a short time, that your wife is not sending you these hidden signals?

No, not really. I mean, my wife has tried, of course. Like I was saying a minute ago, she tells me the late meetings and those little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff. And I try to take her word for it, I really do, but... well, for the past year, they’ve just lined up too precisely to feel accidental. 

Even if I try to brush it off for a day or someone tells me I'm overthinking it, I just can't ignore the pattern. It always comes back to feeling like there’s a private signal in those messages, meant to tell me something she just won’t say directly. So, no, no one has been able to talk me out of it.
Do you have any other thoughts or beliefs that you think might be true, even if others disagree with you?

No, I don't think so. Um... it's really just this situation with my wife. Everything else in my life is pretty standard. I go to work, help my students, come home. I don't have any other... well, theories or anything like that. It's strictly just what we've been talking about today. Nothing else comes to mind.
Has this belief about your wife sending you hidden signals affected your daily life or relationships in any significant way?

Well, it's definitely affected our marriage. We've had a lot of tense conversations about it at home. It gets pretty stressful because we just keep going in circles. Actually, it got to the point where we started seeing a couples therapist, and she's the one who eventually suggested I come in for an individual assessment. 

But outside of that... no, not really. Work is fine. I'm still doing my job as a teaching assistant without any issues, and I'm keeping up with my usual routines, taking care of myself. It's really just the strain it's putting on things between me and my wife.
Has your belief about your wife sending you hidden signals ever changed in intensity or certainty over the past year?

Not really. It's been pretty consistent. I mean, maybe there are days where I'm busier at work and I don't think about it quite as much in the moment, but the certainty hasn't really changed. Since I first started noticing the pattern about a year ago, it's just been a steady fact. I haven't really had any periods where I doubted it or felt more strongly about it—it's just always there, exactly the same.
Have you ever felt like someone else, besides your wife, is hiding something from you or sending you secret messages?

No, not at all. Like I said, it's really just this one specific thing with my wife. I don't think anyone else is doing anything like that. My coworkers, my students, friends... everything is completely normal with them. No secret messages or anything hidden. It's just her.
Have you ever had any other thoughts that you were completely certain of, but others around you did not believe?

No, I can't say that I have. It's really just this one situation with my wife. I don't have any other... unusual beliefs or anything like that. Everything else in my life is just normal, everyday stuff. So, no, nothing else that people have disagreed with me on like this.
Has there ever been any evidence that contradicted your belief about your wife sending you hidden signals?

Well, she denies it, of course. She says the late meetings and those little changes in how she words her work messages are just normal office stuff. But... I mean, for the past year, they've just lined up too precisely. It doesn't feel accidental at all. It's like there's this private signal in them, meant to tell me something she just won't say directly to my face. So, sure, she says it's nothing, but the pattern is right there.
Do you think your belief about your wife sending you hidden signals could be wrong?

I mean... no, I really don't think I'm wrong. I know she says it's just normal office stuff, the late meetings and the way she words things. But like I said, for the past year, it's just too precise. It doesn't feel accidental at all. It's like there's a private signal in those messages, trying to tell me something she won't just say to my face. I just can't see how I could be wrong when the pattern is so clear.
Has your belief about your wife sending you hidden signals ever changed, even slightly, since you first started noticing the patterns?

No, it really hasn't changed. If anything, it's just stayed exactly the same. I know she keeps telling me the late meetings and the way she words her messages are just normal office stuff, but I've been seeing it for a year now. They just line up too precisely. It doesn't feel accidental at all. It's a private signal, meant to tell me something she just won't say directly. So, no, my belief hasn't wavered, because the pattern hasn't changed.
Have you considered the possibility that your interpretation of your wife's actions is not based in reality?

I... no, I haven't really considered that it's not real. I mean, I know how it sounds, and I know she says the late meetings and the way she words her emails are just regular office stuff. But... I've been watching this for a year. It's just too precise. It doesn't feel like an accident or a coincidence. It feels real to me. It's like there's a private signal in there, trying to tell me something she won't just come out and say. So, no, I don't think I'm disconnected from reality. I just think I'm seeing something that's actually there.
Do you think other people would see the same hidden signals in your wife's behavior if they looked at it closely?

I don't know if other people would catch it, honestly. Like I've been saying, she tells me the late meetings and those little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff. And to an outsider, it probably just looks exactly like that. 

But... I've been seeing this for a year now, and the way they line up is just too precise to be accidental. It's a private signal. It's meant to tell me something she won't say directly. So, someone else might miss it completely, because the message is specifically directed at me, not them.
Has there ever been a time when you felt your belief about your wife sending hidden signals was fading away?

No, not really. I feel like I'm repeating myself a bit here, but it hasn't faded at all. I know my wife says the late meetings and the little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff. I hear her when she tells me that. But... for the past year, they’ve just lined up way too precisely to feel accidental. It still feels exactly like there’s a private signal in them, meant to tell me something she won’t say directly. As long as that keeps happening, it's not going to just fade away.
Have you ever had any other beliefs that you were completely certain of, but seemed strange or unlikely to others?

No, I... I can't really think of anything else like that. I've always been a pretty regular guy, you know? Just doing my work at the university, helping with classes... I don't go around coming up with wild theories about things. It's really just this one specific situation with my wife that I've been trying to figure out. I don't have a history of... seeing things that aren't there, or whatever you want to call it. It's just this.
Do you think your belief about your wife sending hidden signals would change if she provided a convincing alternative explanation for the patterns you've observed?

I mean, she already tries to do that. Like I've mentioned a few times now, she constantly tells me that the late meetings and the little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff. That is her explanation. 

But... no, I don't think it would change my mind. I've been looking at this for the past year, and the things she does just line up too precisely to feel accidental. Even if she gives me a logical excuse for each individual thing, it still feels like there’s a private signal in all of it put together. It's meant to tell me something she just won’t say directly to my face. So, no, I don't think another explanation would change things, because the pattern is just too obvious to me.
Have you ever considered that your wife might be telling the truth and there are no hidden signals?

I've tried, I really have. I mean, I know my wife says the late meetings and those little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff. She tells me that, and I try to look at it that way. But... for the past year, they’ve just lined up way too precisely to feel accidental. When I look at the whole picture, it just feels like there’s a private signal in them, meant to tell me something she won’t say directly. So, I hear her, but I just can't believe it's nothing.
